title: Binary Search
description: Search a sorted list by comparing the target with the middle value, then continuing in one half.
note: // rounds down; .size gives the number of elements.
notes: The input list must already be sorted in ascending order. Return the matching index, or -1 when the interval becomes empty.
Both versions use floor division and zero-based indexing. Birdie uses .size for the list length; Python uses len(nums).
